const TOTAL = PUBS.length;

const RTAG={trust:'Trustworthy, Generalizable AI & Neural-Symbolic',eff:'Efficient Learning & Temporal Data',dl:'Deep Learning & Computer Vision'};
const ATAG={health:'Healthcare & AAL',auto:'Automotive & ADAS',agri:'Smart Agriculture',energy:'Energy & Engineering',bio:'Bioinformatics'};
const RC={trust:'background:#EEEDFE;color:#3C3489',eff:'background:#E1F5EE;color:#085041',dl:'background:#E6F1FB;color:#0C447C'};
const AC={health:'background:#FAECE7;color:#712B13',auto:'background:#F1EFE8;color:#444441',agri:'background:#EAF3DE;color:#27500A',energy:'background:#FAEEDA;color:#633806',bio:'background:#FBEAF0;color:#72243E'};

let fR='all',fA='all',fT='all';

function matches(p){
  return (fR==='all'||p.r.includes(fR)) && (fA==='all'||p.a.includes(fA)) && (fT==='all'||p.tp===fT);
}

function pill(label,style,extra=''){
  return `<span style="font-size:10px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:500;${style}${extra}">${label}</span>`;
}

function render(){
  const vis=PUBS.filter(matches);
  document.getElementById('pub-total').innerHTML=`Showing <strong>${vis.length}</strong> of <strong>${TOTAL}</strong> publications`;

  const counts={trust:0,eff:0,dl:0,health:0,auto:0,agri:0,energy:0,bio:0};
  vis.forEach(p=>{
    p.r.forEach(r=>{if(counts[r]!==undefined)counts[r]++});
    p.a.forEach(a=>{if(counts[a]!==undefined)counts[a]++});
  });
  let cr='';
  Object.entries({...RTAG,...ATAG}).forEach(([k,v])=>{
    cr+=`<span style="font-size:11px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:6px;background:#f7f9fc;color:#6c757d;border:1px solid #dde4ed;">${v}: <strong style="color:#1a3a5c">${counts[k]||0}</strong></span> `;
  });
  document.getElementById('pub-counts').innerHTML=cr;

  const byYear={};
  vis.forEach(p=>{(byYear[p.y]=byYear[p.y]||[]).push(p)});
  const years=Object.keys(byYear).sort((a,b)=>b-a);
  let html='';
  years.forEach(y=>{
    html+=`<div style="background:#f7f9fc;border-left:4px solid #2d7dd2;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#1a3a5c;margin:20px 0 6px;border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;">${y}</div>`;
    byYear[y].forEach(p=>{
      let badges='';
      p.r.forEach(r=>{badges+=pill(RTAG[r],RC[r],';margin-right:4px;margin-top:4px;display:inline-block')});
      p.a.forEach(a=>{badges+=pill(ATAG[a],AC[a],';margin-right:4px;margin-top:4px;display:inline-block')});
      if(p.tp==='J') badges+=pill('Journal','background:#e8f1fb;color:#0c447c',';margin-right:4px;margin-top:4px;display:inline-block');
      if(p.tp==='C') badges+=pill('Conference','background:#f1efe8;color:#444441',';margin-right:4px;margin-top:4px;display:inline-block');
      if(p.tp==='B') badges+=pill('Book','background:#eaf3de;color:#27500a',';margin-right:4px;margin-top:4px;display:inline-block');
      if(p.tp==='Ch') badges+=pill('Chapter','background:#fbeaf0;color:#72243e',';margin-right:4px;margin-top:4px;display:inline-block');
      if(p.award) badges+=pill('★ '+p.award,'background:#FAEEDA;color:#633806',';margin-right:4px;margin-top:4px;display:inline-block');
      const href=p.url&&p.url!='#'?`href="${p.url}" target="_blank"`:'';
      html+=`<div style="padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eef0f4;">
        <div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#1a3a5c;margin-bottom:3px;line-height:1.4;">
          ${href?`<a ${href} style="color:#1a3a5c;text-decoration:none;" onmouseover="this.style.color='#2d7dd2'" onmouseout="this.style.color='#1a3a5c'">${p.t}</a>`:p.t}
        </div>
        <div style="font-size:12px;color:#6c757d;margin-bottom:2px;">${p.au}</div>
        <div style="font-size:12px;font-style:italic;color:#2d7dd2;margin-bottom:4px;">${p.v}</div>
        <div>${badges}</div>
      </div>`;
    });
  });
  document.getElementById('pub-list').innerHTML=html||'<p style="color:#6c757d;padding:16px 0;font-size:13px;">No publications match the selected filters.</p>';
}

function setF(el,f,v){
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-fg="'+f+'"]').forEach(x=>{
    x.style.background='white';x.style.color='#6c757d';x.style.borderColor='#dde4ed';
  });
  el.style.background='#1a3a5c';el.style.color='white';el.style.borderColor='#1a3a5c';
  if(f==='r')fR=v; else if(f==='a')fA=v; else fT=v;
  render();
}

function fpill(label,f,v,active){
  const base='font-size:11px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid #dde4ed;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.15s;';
  const style=active?'background:#1a3a5c;color:white;border-color:#1a3a5c;':'background:white;color:#6c757d;';
  return `<span data-fg="${f}" style="${base}${style}" onclick="setF(this,'${f}','${v}')">${label}</span>`;
}

document.getElementById('pub-app').innerHTML=`
  <div style="margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;align-items:center;">
    <span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#6c757d;min-width:90px;">Research</span>
    ${fpill('All','r','all',true)}
    ${fpill('Trustworthy, Generalizable AI &amp; Neural-Symbolic','r','trust',false)}
    ${fpill('Efficient Learning &amp; Temporal Data','r','eff',false)}
    ${fpill('Deep Learning &amp; Computer Vision','r','dl',false)}
  </div>
  <div style="margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;align-items:center;">
    <span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#6c757d;min-width:90px;">Application</span>
    ${fpill('All','a','all',true)}
    ${fpill('Healthcare &amp; AAL','a','health',false)}
    ${fpill('Automotive &amp; ADAS','a','auto',false)}
    ${fpill('Smart Agriculture','a','agri',false)}
    ${fpill('Energy &amp; Engineering','a','energy',false)}
    ${fpill('Bioinformatics','a','bio',false)}
  </div>
  <div style="margin-bottom:16px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;align-items:center;">
    <span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#6c757d;min-width:90px;">Type</span>
    ${fpill('All types','t','all',true)}
    ${fpill('Journal','t','J',false)}
    ${fpill('Conference','t','C',false)}
    ${fpill('Book','t','B',false)}
    ${fpill('Chapter','t','Ch',false)}
  </div>
  <div id="pub-counts" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:10px;"></div>
  <div id="pub-total" style="font-size:13px;color:#6c757d;margin-bottom:4px;"></div>
  <div id="pub-list"></div>
`;

render();
</script>
